title: Insights - Server Timeline

target.rawSql:
SELECT a.RaisedDateTime AS time, CASE a.Severity WHEN 2 THEN 'Critical alert: ' WHEN 1 THEN 'Warning alert: ' ELSE 'Alert: ' END + a.AlertName + ' (' + e.DisplayName + ')' AS text, 'alert' AS tags
FROM Alert.vAlert a
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = a.ManagedEntityRowId
WHERE a.RaisedDateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND (e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId IN (SELECT s.ManagedEntityRowId FROM dbo.vManagedEntity s WHERE s.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote}))
       OR e.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote}))

SELECT TOP 300 r.DateTime AS time, mo.MonitorDefaultName + ' went Critical on ' + en.DisplayName AS text, 'critical' AS tags
FROM State.vStateRaw r
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityMonitor em ON em.ManagedEntityMonitorRowId = r.ManagedEntityMonitorRowId
JOIN dbo.vMonitor mo ON mo.MonitorRowId = em.MonitorRowId
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity en ON en.ManagedEntityRowId = em.ManagedEntityRowId
WHERE r.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND r.NewHealthState = 3 AND r.OldHealthState <> 3
  AND (en.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId IN (SELECT s.ManagedEntityRowId FROM dbo.vManagedEntity s WHERE s.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote})) OR en.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote}))
ORDER BY r.DateTime DESC

panels.description: Alerts raised on the selected servers, or on SCOM objects with their names, in the time range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH srv AS (
  SELECT e.ManagedEntityRowId AS id, e.DisplayName AS name
  FROM dbo.vManagedEntity e
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType t ON t.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId AND t.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName = 'Microsoft.Windows.Computer'
  WHERE e.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote})
),
ent AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.ManagedEntityRowId, e.DisplayName, s.name AS Srv
  FROM dbo.vManagedEntity e
  JOIN srv s ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = s.id OR e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId = s.id OR e.DisplayName = s.name
),
crit AS (
  SELECT r.DateTime, mo.MonitorDefaultName AS monitor, en.DisplayName AS obj, en.Srv AS srv
  FROM State.vStateRaw r
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityMonitor em ON em.ManagedEntityMonitorRowId = r.ManagedEntityMonitorRowId
  JOIN dbo.vMonitor mo ON mo.MonitorRowId = em.MonitorRowId
  JOIN ent en ON en.ManagedEntityRowId = em.ManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE r.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND r.NewHealthState = 3 AND r.OldHealthState <> 3
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Alert.vAlert a JOIN ent en ON en.ManagedEntityRowId = a.ManagedEntityRowId WHERE a.RaisedDateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AS Alerts,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crit) AS "Critical changes",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Event.vEvent ev JOIN dbo.vEventLoggingComputer lc ON lc.EventLoggingComputerRowId = ev.LoggingComputerRowId JOIN srv s ON s.name = lc.ComputerName WHERE ev.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND ev.EventLevelId = 1) AS "Windows errors",
  (SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(varchar(19), c.DateTime, 120) + ' UTC' FROM crit c ORDER BY c.DateTime, c.monitor) AS "First critical change",
  (SELECT TOP 1 c.monitor + ' on ' + c.obj + CASE WHEN c.obj = c.srv THEN '' ELSE ' (' + c.srv + ')' END FROM crit c ORDER BY c.DateTime, c.monitor) AS "First critical monitor"

panels.title: First critical monitor

panels.description: Markers: red = an alert was raised, orange = a monitor went Critical.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, metric, value FROM (
  SELECT DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0) AS time, h.DisplayName AS metric, AVG(p.SampleValue) AS value
  FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 2880
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND r.ObjectName = 'Processor Information' AND r.CounterName = '% Processor Time'
    AND (i.InstanceName IN ('_Total','') OR '_Total' = '*')
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote})
  GROUP BY DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0), h.DisplayName
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.DateTime, h.DisplayName, AVG(p.AverageValue)
  FROM Perf.vPerfHourly p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE (DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) > 2880 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Perf.vPerfRaw x WHERE x.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()))
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND r.ObjectName = 'Processor Information' AND r.CounterName = '% Processor Time'
    AND (i.InstanceName IN ('_Total','') OR '_Total' = '*')
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote})
  GROUP BY p.DateTime, h.DisplayName
) x ORDER BY time

panels.title: Memory % used

panels.description: One row per selected server, earliest first. When several servers are involved in one incident, the server at the top is the best place to start. It shows the order things happened in, not proof of cause.

defaults.noValue: Nothing recorded in this time range

targets.rawSql:
WITH srv AS (
  SELECT e.ManagedEntityRowId AS id, e.DisplayName AS name
  FROM dbo.vManagedEntity e
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType t ON t.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId AND t.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName = 'Microsoft.Windows.Computer'
  WHERE e.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote})
),
ent AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.ManagedEntityRowId, e.DisplayName, s.name AS Srv
  FROM dbo.vManagedEntity e
  JOIN srv s ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = s.id OR e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId = s.id OR e.DisplayName = s.name
),
crit AS (
  SELECT en.Srv, r.DateTime, mo.MonitorDefaultName AS monitor, en.DisplayName AS obj,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY en.Srv ORDER BY r.DateTime, mo.MonitorDefaultName) AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY en.Srv) AS n
  FROM State.vStateRaw r
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityMonitor em ON em.ManagedEntityMonitorRowId = r.ManagedEntityMonitorRowId
  JOIN dbo.vMonitor mo ON mo.MonitorRowId = em.MonitorRowId
  JOIN ent en ON en.ManagedEntityRowId = em.ManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE r.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND r.NewHealthState = 3 AND r.OldHealthState <> 3
),
al AS (
  SELECT en.Srv, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM Alert.vAlert a JOIN ent en ON en.ManagedEntityRowId = a.ManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE a.RaisedDateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY en.Srv
)
SELECT s.name AS Server,
       c.DateTime AS "First critical change",
       c.monitor + CASE WHEN c.obj = s.name THEN '' ELSE ' on ' + c.obj END AS "First critical monitor",
       COALESCE(c.n, 0) AS "Critical changes",
       COALESCE(a.n, 0) AS Alerts
FROM srv s
LEFT JOIN crit c ON c.Srv = s.name AND c.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN al a ON a.Srv = s.name
ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.DateTime IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, c.DateTime, s.name

panels.title: Which server went Critical first

panels.description: A burst of alerts at one moment usually has one cause.

targets.rawSql:
WITH srv AS (
  SELECT e.ManagedEntityRowId AS id, e.DisplayName AS name
  FROM dbo.vManagedEntity e
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType t ON t.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId AND t.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName = 'Microsoft.Windows.Computer'
  WHERE e.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote})
),
ent AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.ManagedEntityRowId
  FROM dbo.vManagedEntity e
  JOIN srv s ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = s.id OR e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId = s.id OR e.DisplayName = s.name
)
SELECT DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, a.RaisedDateTime) / 5) * 5, 0) AS time,
       CASE a.Severity WHEN 2 THEN 'Critical' WHEN 1 THEN 'Warning' ELSE 'Information' END AS metric,
       COUNT(*) AS value
FROM Alert.vAlert a
JOIN ent en ON en.ManagedEntityRowId = a.ManagedEntityRowId
WHERE a.RaisedDateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, a.RaisedDateTime) / 5) * 5, 0), CASE a.Severity WHEN 2 THEN 'Critical' WHEN 1 THEN 'Warning' ELSE 'Information' END
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Alerts raised (5-minute buckets)

panels.description: Monitors that are Warning or Critical right now on this server and what runs on it. The oldest is the best starting point: the later ones often follow from it.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 300
  s.LastModified AS "Unhealthy since",
  CASE s.HealthState WHEN 3 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Warning' END AS Health,
  COALESCE((SELECT TOP 1 m.DisplayName FROM dbo.MonitorView m WHERE m.Id = s.MonitorId AND m.DisplayName IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.LanguageCode), s.MonitorName) AS Monitor,
  COALESCE(h.DisplayName, b.DisplayName) AS Server,
  b.DisplayName AS Object
FROM dbo.StateView s
JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity b ON b.BaseManagedEntityId = s.BaseManagedEntityId
LEFT JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity h ON h.BaseManagedEntityId = b.TopLevelHostEntityId
WHERE s.HealthState IN (2, 3) AND b.IsDeleted = 0
  AND (b.BaseManagedEntityId IN (SELECT c.Id FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView c WHERE c.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote}) AND c.IsDeleted = 0)
       OR b.TopLevelHostEntityId IN (SELECT c.Id FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView c WHERE c.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote}) AND c.IsDeleted = 0)
       OR b.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote}))
  AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.MonitorView m WHERE m.Id = s.MonitorId AND m.IsUnitMonitor = 1)
       OR s.MonitorName = 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthService.Heartbeat')
  AND s.MonitorName NOT IN ('System.Health.EntityState', 'System.Health.AvailabilityState', 'System.Health.ConfigurationState', 'System.Health.PerformanceState', 'System.Health.SecurityState')
ORDER BY s.LastModified ASC

panels.title: Unhealthy now, oldest first

panels.description: Alerts raised and closed, monitor health changes, maintenance mode and Windows events on the selected servers, newest first (sort by Time to read it in order). The 500 most recent rows in the time range.

defaults.noValue: Nothing recorded in this time range

targets.rawSql:
WITH srv AS (
  SELECT e.ManagedEntityRowId AS id, e.DisplayName AS name
  FROM dbo.vManagedEntity e
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType t ON t.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId AND t.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName = 'Microsoft.Windows.Computer'
  WHERE e.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote})
),
ent AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.ManagedEntityRowId, e.DisplayName, s.name AS Srv
  FROM dbo.vManagedEntity e
  JOIN srv s ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = s.id OR e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId = s.id OR e.DisplayName = s.name
),
al AS (
  SELECT TOP 500 a.RaisedDateTime AS Time, CAST('Alert raised' AS varchar(20)) AS Type,
         CAST(CASE a.Severity WHEN 2 THEN 'Critical' WHEN 1 THEN 'Warning' ELSE 'Information' END AS varchar(20)) AS Severity,
         CAST(a.AlertName AS nvarchar(400)) AS What, CAST(en.DisplayName AS nvarchar(400)) AS Source, CAST(en.Srv AS nvarchar(400)) AS Server
  FROM Alert.vAlert a JOIN ent en ON en.ManagedEntityRowId = a.ManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE a.RaisedDateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  ORDER BY a.RaisedDateTime DESC
),
cl AS (
  SELECT TOP 500 rs.StateSetDateTime AS Time, CAST('Alert closed' AS varchar(20)) AS Type, CAST('Information' AS varchar(20)) AS Severity,
         CAST(a.AlertName AS nvarchar(400)) AS What, CAST(en.DisplayName AS nvarchar(400)) AS Source, CAST(en.Srv AS nvarchar(400)) AS Server
  FROM Alert.vAlertResolutionState rs
  JOIN Alert.vAlert a ON a.AlertGuid = rs.AlertGuid
  JOIN ent en ON en.ManagedEntityRowId = a.ManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE rs.ResolutionState = 255 AND rs.StateSetDateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  ORDER BY rs.StateSetDateTime DESC
),
hc AS (
  SELECT TOP 500 r.DateTime AS Time, CAST('Health change' AS varchar(20)) AS Type,
         CAST(CASE r.NewHealthState WHEN 3 THEN 'Critical' WHEN 2 THEN 'Warning' WHEN 1 THEN 'Healthy' ELSE 'Not monitored' END AS varchar(20)) AS Severity,
         CAST(mo.MonitorDefaultName + ': ' + CASE r.OldHealthState WHEN 3 THEN 'Critical' WHEN 2 THEN 'Warning' WHEN 1 THEN 'Healthy' ELSE 'Not monitored' END + ' to ' + CASE r.NewHealthState WHEN 3 THEN 'Critical' WHEN 2 THEN 'Warning' WHEN 1 THEN 'Healthy' ELSE 'Not monitored' END AS nvarchar(400)) AS What,
         CAST(en.DisplayName AS nvarchar(400)) AS Source, CAST(en.Srv AS nvarchar(400)) AS Server
  FROM State.vStateRaw r
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityMonitor em ON em.ManagedEntityMonitorRowId = r.ManagedEntityMonitorRowId
  JOIN dbo.vMonitor mo ON mo.MonitorRowId = em.MonitorRowId
  JOIN ent en ON en.ManagedEntityRowId = em.ManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE r.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  ORDER BY r.DateTime DESC
),
mt AS (
  SELECT TOP 200 mm.StartDateTime AS Time, CAST('Maintenance mode' AS varchar(20)) AS Type, CAST('Information' AS varchar(20)) AS Severity,
         CAST('Entered maintenance mode' AS nvarchar(400)) AS What, CAST(en.DisplayName AS nvarchar(400)) AS Source, CAST(en.Srv AS nvarchar(400)) AS Server
  FROM dbo.vMaintenanceMode mm JOIN ent en ON en.ManagedEntityRowId = mm.ManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE mm.StartDateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  ORDER BY mm.StartDateTime DESC
),
mt2 AS (
  SELECT TOP 200 mm.EndDateTime AS Time, CAST('Maintenance mode' AS varchar(20)) AS Type, CAST('Information' AS varchar(20)) AS Severity,
         CAST('Left maintenance mode' AS nvarchar(400)) AS What, CAST(en.DisplayName AS nvarchar(400)) AS Source, CAST(en.Srv AS nvarchar(400)) AS Server
  FROM dbo.vMaintenanceMode mm JOIN ent en ON en.ManagedEntityRowId = mm.ManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE mm.EndDateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  ORDER BY mm.EndDateTime DESC
),
evs AS (
  SELECT TOP 300 ev.DateTime AS Time, CAST('Windows event' AS varchar(20)) AS Type, CAST(CASE ev.EventLevelId WHEN 1 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Warning' END AS varchar(20)) AS Severity,
         CAST(COALESCE(p.EventPublisherName, '') + ' ' + CAST(ev.EventNumber & 65535 AS varchar(10)) + ': ' + LEFT(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(d.RenderedDescription, d.RawDescription, ''), CHAR(13), ' '), CHAR(10), ' '), 250) AS nvarchar(400)) AS What,
         CAST(lc.ComputerName AS nvarchar(400)) AS Source, CAST(s.name AS nvarchar(400)) AS Server
  FROM Event.vEvent ev
  JOIN dbo.vEventLoggingComputer lc ON lc.EventLoggingComputerRowId = ev.LoggingComputerRowId
  JOIN srv s ON s.name = lc.ComputerName
  LEFT JOIN dbo.vEventPublisher p ON p.EventPublisherRowId = ev.EventPublisherRowId
  LEFT JOIN Event.vEventDetail d ON d.EventOriginId = ev.EventOriginId
  WHERE ev.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND (ev.EventLevelId = 1 OR (ev.EventLevelId = 2 AND '${events}' = 'Errors and warnings'))
    AND '${events}' <> 'None'
  ORDER BY ev.DateTime DESC
)
SELECT TOP 500 x.Time, x.Type, x.Severity, x.Server, x.What, x.Source
FROM (SELECT * FROM al UNION ALL SELECT * FROM cl UNION ALL SELECT * FROM hc UNION ALL SELECT * FROM mt UNION ALL SELECT * FROM mt2 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM evs) x
ORDER BY x.Time DESC
